meta.name: close-case-artifact
meta.description: Close a case or alert with proper reason and documentation. Use when triage determines an alert is FP/BTP or investigation is complete. Requires artifact ID, type, closure reason, and root cause.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 关闭安全告警并记录处置原因
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在安全运营中规范关闭告警或案件。
copy.tagline_en: Close security alerts with proper documentation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to formally close security alerts or cases with reasons.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你关闭安全案件或告警，需要提供案件/告警 ID、类型、关闭理由、根本原因和备注。关闭理由包括：恶意、非恶意、维护、不确定、未知。
howto.when: 当安全人员判断告警是误报或调查完成需要关闭案件时触发。需要用户提供案件 ID、关闭理由等信息。

say.text: 关闭案件 CASE-123，理由误报，根因为正常行为。
say.note: Claude 会执行关闭操作并返回状态。

say.text: 关闭告警 ALERT-456，理由恶意，根因为恶意软件。
say.note: 需要预先获取根本原因列表。

howto.what_en: Claude can close a case or alert with a reason, root cause, and comment. Requires artifact ID, type, closure reason (MALICIOUS, NOT_MALICIOUS, MAINTENANCE, INCONCLUSIVE, UNKNOWN), root cause, and comment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when triage determines an alert is FP/BTP or investigation is complete. Requires user to provide artifact ID, closure reason, etc.

say_en.text: Close case CASE-123, reason NOT_MALICIOUS, root cause 'Normal behavior'.
say_en.note: Claude executes closure and returns status.

say_en.text: Close alert ALERT-456, reason MALICIOUS, root cause 'Malware'.
say_en.note: Need to list root causes first if unsure.
